paper.title: Cost-Effective Online Multi-LLM Selection with Versatile Reward Models

settings.name_in_paper: C2MAB-V: cost-effective combinatorial multi-armed bandit with versatile reward models (AWC/SUC/AIC) and long-term cost constraint
unmapped: Long-term average budget constraint with unknown stochastic costs; performance also measured by constraint violation V(T) = [ (1/T) sum_t sum_{k in F_t} y_{t,k} - rho ]^+
Partial (probabilistically triggered) feedback: only a subset F_t of selected arms observed, with minimum full-observation probability o*
Non-linear reward functions (AWC: 1-prod(1-mu_k), SUC: sum mu_k, AIC: prod mu_k), L-Lipschitz and monotone
alpha-approximate regret with an alpha-approximation oracle (alpha = 1-1/e for AWC, 1 for SUC/AIC)
Feasible actions: matroid / cardinality-constrained subsets of size at most (or exactly) N; learner knows budget rho

bound.expression_latex: R(T) \leq  \frac{2 L}{o^*} \sqrt{2 N K T \ln \left(\frac{2 \pi^2 K T}{3 }\right)}+\left(K+1\right)r^*

symbols.o_star: minimum probability that all selected LLMs in an action are observed
symbols.m: N in the paper: maximum number of LLMs selected per action

conditions: reward function is monotone and L-Lipschitz (AWC, SUC or AIC)

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: With $\delta=1/T$ in the confidence radius, the $\alpha$-approximate regret for the multi-LLM selection problem is bounded as follows, with probability at least $1-1/T$: R(T) \leq  \frac{2 L}{o^*} \sqrt{2 N K T \ln \left(\frac{2 \pi^2 K T}{3 }\right)}+\left(K+1\right)r^*.

results.notes: Regret is alpha-approximate (alpha = 1-1/e for AWC, 1 for SUC/AIC) and defined as an expectation, yet stated 'with probability at least 1-1/T'; recorded as high-probability as stated. L_lip is the paper's L (Lipschitz constant of the reward).

symbols.m: N in the paper: maximum number of LLMs selected per action

conditions: worst case for AWC: all selected LLMs are used (S_t = F_t)

source.label: thm:violation
source.quote: With $\delta=1/T$ in the confidence radius, the constraint violation under the worst case is bounded as follows, with probability at least $1-1/T$: V(T) \leq \sqrt{NK/T} \left(2 \sqrt{2\ln \left(\frac{2 \pi^2 K T}{3 }\right)}+\sqrt{NK/T}\right).

results.notes: Bound on the average per-round budget constraint violation V(T) (not regret), recorded as stated (not multiplied by T); paper notes total violation is O~(sqrt(KT)).

cited_results.cited_title: Tight regret bounds for stochastic combinatorial semi-bandits
cited_results.setting_description: Stochastic combinatorial semi-bandit with linear reward, full semi-bandit feedback, K base arms, actions of size N
